title: Election
description: An electoral event on a given date, containing one or more contests. schema.org has no Election, Candidate, Ballot or constituency of any kind - only PoliticalParty, which is used - so this profile is minted over NIST SP 1500-100 and VIP. Closes a loop left open by the org profile: org records that a Post is filled by election and how long a term runs, but nothing about the election that produced the officeholder.

name.description: The election's title, e.g. 'Example City general election, 2022'.

description.description: A plain-language summary of the election, when the name alone isn't enough.

url.description: Where this election's canonical human-readable page lives.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this election beyond its `@id`.

electionDate.description: Polling day. Where voting spans several days, the final day.

administeredBy.description: The GovernmentOrganization running the election, which is frequently not the body being elected.

jurisdiction.description: The `Jurisdiction` this election is held in.

registeredVoters.description: The electorate for the election as a whole. See `Contest.registeredVoters` for the per-contest figure, which is what turnout should actually be measured against.

ballotsCast.description: Ballots cast across the election. With registeredVoters this yields turnout; publishing turnout as a derived percentage instead loses the ability to recompute it on a corrected register.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
